name: seis-plugin-capability-coverage
description: Summarize bounded declared SEIS Repo plugin capability coverage without writing, networking, or exposing registry contents.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize declared public SEIS plugin coverage safely.
interface.longDescription: Reads only five fixed checked-in public SEIS Repo registry projections, including the public bundle catalog, and returns derived category counts, normalized capability-token frequencies, and reconciliation counts. It never returns raw registry content, follows symlinks, writes files, uses a network, reads secrets, inspects arbitrary paths, or treats static metadata as installation, runtime, provider, deployment, signing, or release proof.
defaultPrompt: Summarize declared public SEIS Repo plugin capability coverage from the fixed local registry projections.
Keep static registry metadata separate from installation, runtime, provider, deployment, signing, and release claims.
